  <style>
    /* CSS Variables & Theme Support */
    :root {
      --color-text-primary: #0f172a;
      --color-text-secondary: #475569;
      --color-background-primary: #f8fafc;
      --color-background-secondary: #ffffff;
      --color-border-primary: #cbd5e1;
      --color-accent: #2563eb;
      --color-accent-hover: #1d4ed8;
      --color-success: #16a34a;
      --color-danger: #dc2626;
      --color-warning: #ea580c;
      --border-radius-sm: 8px;
      --border-radius-md: 12px;
      --border-radius-lg: 18px;
      --font-sans: 'Inter', system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif;
      --font-mono: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Monaco, Consolas, monospace;
      --shadow-sm: 0 1px 2px 0 rgb(0 0 0 / 0.05);
      --shadow-md: 0 4px 6px -1px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.1), 0 2px 4px -2px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.1);
      --shadow-lg: 0 10px 15px -3px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.1), 0 4px 6px -4px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.1);
    }

    @media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) {
      :root {
        --color-text-primary: #f8fafc;
        --color-text-secondary: #94a3b8;
        --color-background-primary: #0f172a;
        --color-background-secondary: #1e293b;
        --color-border-primary: #334155;
        --color-accent: #3b82f6;
        --color-accent-hover: #60a5fa;
        --color-success: #22c55e;
        --color-danger: #ef4444;
        --color-warning: #f97316;
        --shadow-sm: 0 1px 2px 0 rgb(0 0 0 / 0.5);
        --shadow-md: 0 4px 6px -1px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.3), 0 2px 4px -2px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.3);
        --shadow-lg: 0 10px 15px -3px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.4), 0 4px 6px -4px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.4);
      }
    }

    * {
      box-sizing: border-box;
      transition: background-color 0.2s, border-color 0.2s;
    }

    body {
      background-color: var(--color-background-primary);
      color: var(--color-text-primary);
      font-family: var(--font-sans);
      margin: 0;
      padding: 2rem 1.5rem;
      min-height: 100vh;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      align-items: center;
    }

    .container {
      width: 100%;
      max-width: 1200px;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 2rem;
    }

    /* Header styling */
    .header {
      text-align: center;
      margin-bottom: 1rem;
    }

    .header-logo {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      width: 64px;
      height: 64px;
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, #ef4444, #f97316);
      border-radius: var(--border-radius-md);
      color: white;
      font-size: 2rem;
      margin-bottom: 1rem;
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-md);
    }

    .header h1 {
      margin: 0;
      font-size: 2.25rem;
      font-weight: 800;
      letter-spacing: -0.025em;
      background: linear-gradient(to right, #ef4444, #f97316);
      -webkit-background-clip: text;
      -webkit-text-fill-color: transparent;
    }

    .header p {
      color: var(--color-text-secondary);
      margin: 0.5rem 0 0;
      font-size: 1.125rem;
      max-width: 600px;
      margin-left: auto;
      margin-right: auto;
    }

    /* App Layout */
    .app-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 1fr;
      gap: 2rem;
    }

    @media (min-width: 900px) {
      .app-grid {
        grid-template-columns: 420px 1fr;
      }
    }

    /* Card styling */
    .card {
      background-color: var(--color-background-secondary);
      border: 1px solid var(--color-border-primary);
      border-radius: var(--border-radius-lg);
      padding: 2rem;
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm);
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 1.5rem;
    }

    .card-title {
      margin: 0;
      font-size: 1.25rem;
      font-weight: 700;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 0.5rem;
    }

    /* Form Fields */
    .form-group {
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 0.5rem;
    }

    .form-label {
      font-size: 0.875rem;
      font-weight: 600;
      color: var(--color-text-secondary);
    }

    .input-wrapper {
      position: relative;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
    }

    .input-prefix {
      position: absolute;
      left: 1rem;
      color: var(--color-text-secondary);
      font-weight: 500;
      pointer-events: none;
    }

    .input-suffix {
      position: absolute;
      right: 1rem;
      color: var(--color-text-secondary);
      font-weight: 500;
      pointer-events: none;
    }

    .input-field {
      width: 100%;
      padding: 0.75rem 1rem;
      border-radius: var(--border-radius-sm);
      border: 1px solid var(--color-border-primary);
      background-color: var(--color-background-primary);
      color: var(--color-text-primary);
      font-size: 1rem;
      font-weight: 500;
      outline: none;
      transition: border-color 0.15s, box-shadow 0.15s;
    }

    .input-field:focus {
      border-color: var(--color-accent);
      box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(37, 99, 235, 0.15);
    }

    .input-field.has-prefix {
      padding-left: 2rem;
    }

    .input-field.has-suffix {
      padding-right: 2rem;
    }

    /* Tabs/Toggle */
    .tabs-container {
      display: flex;
      background-color: var(--color-background-primary);
      border-radius: var(--border-radius-sm);
      padding: 0.25rem;
      border: 1px solid var(--color-border-primary);
    }

    .tab-btn {
      flex: 1;
      background: none;
      border: none;
      padding: 0.5rem;
      font-size: 0.875rem;
      font-weight: 600;
      color: var(--color-text-secondary);
      cursor: pointer;
      border-radius: calc(var(--border-radius-sm) - 2px);
      transition: all 0.15s;
    }

    .tab-btn.active {
      background-color: var(--color-background-secondary);
      color: var(--color-text-primary);
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm);
    }

    /* Dashboards / Outputs */
    .dashboard-container {
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 1.5rem;
    }

    /* Comparison Card */
    .savings-banner {
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(22, 163, 74, 0.15), rgba(34, 197, 94, 0.05));
      border: 2px solid var(--color-success);
      border-radius: var(--border-radius-lg);
      padding: 1.5rem;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 1rem;
    }

    .savings-header {
      font-size: 1.1rem;
      font-weight: 700;
      color: var(--color-success);
      margin: 0;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 0.5rem;
    }

    .savings-stats {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 1fr;
      gap: 1rem;
    }

    @media (min-width: 600px) {
      .savings-stats {
        grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
      }
    }

    .savings-stat {
      background-color: var(--color-background-secondary);
      border: 1px solid var(--color-border-primary);
      padding: 1rem;
      border-radius: var(--border-radius-md);
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm);
    }

    .savings-val {
      font-size: 1.75rem;
      font-weight: 800;
      color: var(--color-success);
    }

    .savings-label {
      font-size: 0.8rem;
      font-weight: 600;
      color: var(--color-text-secondary);
      text-transform: uppercase;
      letter-spacing: 0.05em;
      margin-top: 0.25rem;
    }

    /* Scenario Comparison Grid */
    .scenarios-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 1fr;
      gap: 1.5rem;
    }

    @media (min-width: 600px) {
      .scenarios-grid {
        grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
      }
    }

    .scenario-card {
      border: 1px solid var(--color-border-primary);
      border-radius: var(--border-radius-md);
      padding: 1.5rem;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 1.25rem;
      background-color: var(--color-background-secondary);
    }

    .scenario-card.s1 {
      border-top: 4px solid var(--color-danger);
    }

    .scenario-card.s2 {
      border-top: 4px solid var(--color-success);
    }

    .scenario-name {
      font-size: 0.95rem;
      font-weight: 700;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      letter-spacing: 0.05em;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 0.5rem;
    }

    .scenario-name.s1-name { color: var(--color-danger); }
    .scenario-name.s2-name { color: var(--color-success); }

    .stat-row {
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 0.25rem;
    }

    .stat-label {
      font-size: 0.85rem;
      color: var(--color-text-secondary);
      font-weight: 500;
    }

    .stat-value {
      font-size: 1.5rem;
      font-weight: 800;
    }

    .stat-value.primary-val {
      font-size: 1.85rem;
    }

    /* Stacked Progress Bar */
    .progress-bar-container {
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 0.4rem;

Build a single-page web app called "Credit Card Minimum Payment Trap Calculator" using HTML, CSS, and Vanilla JavaScript only — no backend, no login, no external APIs.

Inputs:

Current balance (number)
Annual interest rate (APR %)
Minimum payment method: percentage of balance (default 3%) OR fixed monthly amount — let user pick one
Optional extra payment per month

Simulation logic (run in JS):
For each month: add monthly interest to balance, calculate minimum payment based on chosen method, add extra payment if given, apply payment to balance, repeat until balance reaches zero (cap at 600 months to avoid infinite loop).

Run two scenarios: (1) minimum payment only, (2) minimum + extra payment.

Results dashboard — display for both scenarios side by side:

Total interest paid
Total amount paid
Months and years to debt-free
Interest saved and time saved (scenario 2 vs scenario 1)

Add 2-3 short "smart insight" text lines based on results, e.g. "Most of your payment is going toward interest" or "Paying extra saves you X years."

Keep UI clean, modern, mobile-friendly, single file (HTML+CSS+JS combined).
